questions.question: What is distinctive about the tone of Psalm 88?
options: It is a wisdom psalm about the two very different paths of life
It is a joyful hymn of thanksgiving for a great deliverance
It is one of the darkest laments, ending without resolution
It is a royal psalm written for the coronation of the king
questions.answer: It is one of the darkest laments, ending without resolution

questions.question: How does the psalmist describe his condition?
options: His soul is full of troubles and his life draws near to Sheol
His barns are full to the brim and his cup overflows with plenty
His enemies are all scattered abroad and his foes are put to flight
His heart is exceedingly glad and his tongue rejoices in the LORD
questions.answer: His soul is full of troubles and his life draws near to Sheol

questions.question: The psalmist cries out to God day and night.
O LORD, God of my salvation, I cry out day and _____ before you.
You have caused my beloved and my friend to shun me; my companions have become _____.
